priorities.rationale: I build local-first software; I want passages about on-device inference and self-hosted models to stand out.
Two kids in public school. I want to see what actually happens to their data, not vendor reassurances.

trusted.note: They publish their testing methodology and print corrections. Checked their benchmark writeups twice; both held up.

distrusted.note: Recycled press releases with invented statistics. Twice caught fabricating survey numbers.
